biggest_catch: Your friend has to physically open the account at a TD Bank store - online account opening does not count.
catches: The referred client must open their new TD personal checking account at a TD Store (in-branch) - online openings don't qualify.
Referring client must have an existing TD personal checking account AND be enrolled in Online Banking to get a unique Share the Green offer code.

The friend must provide your offer code at account opening and, within 60 days, either receive a $250+ qualifying direct deposit (payroll/pension/government benefits - not bank transfers or P2P) OR complete 15+ qualifying TD Visa debit purchases.
Referred clients with an existing TD personal checking account, one closed within the last 12 months, or who previously earned a Share the Green bonus are excluded.
If the new checking account is closed within 6 months after opening and the bonus was paid, TD can claw back the bonus at closing.
Max ten (10) Share the Green bonuses ($1,000 total) per calendar year; employees and non-US residents are ineligible.

steps: Be a TD Bank personal checking customer enrolled in Online Banking and get your unique Share the Green offer code.
Share your offer code with a friend (new TD personal checking customer; no TD personal checking now or closed within 12 months).
Your friend opens a new TD personal checking account at a TD Store (in-branch), providing your offer code at account opening.
Within 60 days of account opening, the friend either receives a qualifying direct deposit of $250+ (payroll, pension, or government benefits) or completes 15+ qualifying TD Visa debit purchases.
You receive $100 credited to your TD personal checking account no later than 95 days from the new account opening date (up to 10 referrals, $1,000 per calendar year).
